T: Coffee for the coach. Orange slices for the team.
D: A mild vitamin salesman coaches his son's under-10 soccer team and gets badly hooked on coffee along the way.
P: Serve the coffee when Phil takes his first sip and the season turns.
S: Cold navel oranges cut into wedges, exactly what every kids' team eats at halftime. Cut 6 navel oranges into wedges, keeping the skin on.
Nuts, seeds and dried fruit tossed with a little dark chocolate, the healthy snack Phil would sell you.
M: the end of season team barbecue
Grilled beef sausages in bread with fried onions and sauce, the end-of-season team feed. Grill 12 beef sausages until browned and cooked through.
W: the coffee shop where it all starts
Crunchy almond biscotti twice-baked for dunking, the perfect thing to have with far too much coffee.
K: Phil discovers coffee and never looks back
Strong plunger coffee with plenty of milk and sugar, the cup that turns a mild dad into a madman.

s.how: Cut 6 navel oranges into wedges, keeping the skin on. Pile into a bowl of ice and serve straight away at halftime. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.
Toss 200g mixed nuts, 100g pumpkin seeds, 100g dried cranberries, 100g dried apricots and 100g dark chocolate chunks in a big bowl. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: the end of season team barbecue
m.how: Grill 12 beef sausages until browned and cooked through. Fry 3 sliced onions in butter until soft and golden. Serve each sausage in a slice of white bread with onions, tomato sauce and mustard.

w.note: the coffee shop where it all starts
w.how: Mix 250g plain flour, 200g sugar, 1 tsp baking powder, 3 eggs and 150g whole almonds into a dough. Shape 2 logs and bake at 180C for 25 minutes. Cool 10 minutes, slice thinly and bake 10 minutes more until crisp.

d.note: Phil discovers coffee and never looks back
d.how: Add 60g coarse ground coffee to a plunger, pour over 1L water just off the boil and steep 4 minutes. Press and pour into 4 big mugs with milk and sugar to taste.
